content:
The **Devil's Backbone** is a location in Appalachia.

Devil's Backbone is a natural arch of Tuscarora sandstone. [Pub 1] This landmark is located a short distance to the east of Huntersville, off State Route 107. [Pub 1] It features pre-War marked hiking trails.

A camping spot is found below the flagpole along the peak, near some graves by a pond. The nearby bridge leads to the Trapper's Camp unmarked location, northeast of the camping spot.

The Devil's Backbone appears in *Fallout 76*.

The Devil's Backbone is a real-world location of the same name.
